question: The Konark Dance Festival is held at an open-air auditorium in the backdrop of the _______ which is also known as the Black Pagoda.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Sun Temple.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Konark Dance Festival is held at an open-air auditorium in the backdrop of the Sun Temple which is also known as the Black Pagoda.**
 
• A UNESCO World Heritage site, Konark Sun Temple is famous for its unique architecture. 
 
• Its geometrical patterns and carved wheels are used to serve as sundials. One can witness three images of Sun God in three directions to catch the rays of the Sun at dawn, noon, and sunset.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• The Somnath temple,__ also called Somanātha temple or Deo Patan, is a Hindu temple located in Prabhas Patan, Veraval in Gujarat, India. It is one of the most sacred pilgrimage sites for Hindus and is believed to be the first among the twelve jyotirlinga shrines of Shiva.
 
• Guruvayur Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to the Lord Guruvayurappan, Under the Administration of Guruvayur Devaswom, located in the town of Guruvayur in Kerala, India.
 
• __The Kamakhya Temple __at Nilacal hills in Guwahati, Assam is one of the oldest and most revered centres of Tantric practices.
